capabilities.summary: Seven-beat home page in a fixed ascending (root→crown) order, content-driven from published LandingSections
Products block rendering live Courses, Workshops and Services at equal billing with real dates and prices
Index and detail pages for each of the three offering kinds
Course detail lists its Sessions with dates
Booking-request form against any Offering, with spam guard and rate limit
Live free-slot picker for services, computed from the owner's calendar, placing a self-expiring hold on the chosen time
Email acknowledgement to the visitor and email notification to the owner on a booking request
Newsletter subscription with double opt-in and one-click unsubscribe from every issue
PDF downloads: public documents direct, subscriber-only documents via signed expiring links
About and contact pages
Privacy notice at /privacy, linked from the footer and from both the booking and subscribe forms, covering the two purposes separately
Configurable page background from a curated set or a plain ground, with an optional sparse procedural star field that is decorative only and suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion
Full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance verified by computed contrast, not by eye
Single-account login, rate-limited, with emailed password recovery
Edit all seven landing beats: eyebrow, heading, body, image, and a link on the three beats that have one
Show/hide beats 2-6; beats 1 and 7 are always visible and cannot be hidden
Draft → preview → publish: edits are never live until published, and preview renders the real page from draft content
One publish covers both the seven landing beats and SiteSettings, with a confirmation itemising everything going live
Create, edit, activate and deactivate Services, Workshops and Courses
Add, order and edit a Course's Sessions
Set prices per Offering; no price is hard-coded anywhere
Booking-request queue with status transitions
Media library holding the six supplied plates plus owner uploads
Uploads are auto-processed — cropped to the target ratio for their slot and given a palette treatment so anything the owner adds lands inside the site's visual world
Alt text is required on every image before it can be used
Site settings: contact details, bio, credentials, social links, background selection, and hold duration
One merged calendar showing confirmed bookings, pending holds, workshop/course sessions and personal blocks, in month and week views
Workshops and course sessions block the calendar automatically on publish and unblock when moved or removed — the owner never blocks her own events by hand
Personal time blocking in one gesture from the calendar itself
A recurring weekly availability pattern, plus buffer, minimum lead time and booking horizon
Free slots for a service derived by subtraction — never stored, never editable as a list, never able to disagree with the calendar
Hold lifecycle: placed on request, released on decline or expiry, converted on confirm
Public subscribe form with explicit unticked consent, double opt-in, and a confirmation email
One-click unsubscribe via signed token in every issue, no login required
Permanent suppression of unsubscribed and bounced addresses across every send path
Issue composition from a small fixed block set, with an upcoming-offerings block that pulls live dates
Her branding is the template, not an option — logo, palette, type and footer applied automatically to every issue, including the legally required identification and unsubscribe link
Test send to herself before any broadcast
Batched send with a confirmation naming the exact recipient count
Subscriber list with status, source, search, CSV export and manual unsubscribe
PDF library with title, description and visibility
Attach one or more Documents to a newsletter issue
Offer a Document with a subscribe form as the reason to join
Signed, expiring links for subscriber-only documents
Reference view before deletion — the owner can see which newsletters and forms reference a document before removing it
Index screens design their EMPTY state — a new practitioner has zero workshops on day one and the page must still be worth landing on
booking-request designs the slot-taken-while-you-were-typing state, preserving already-typed field values
booking-confirmation states the held time plainly and that it is held rather than booked until the owner replies
subscribe-confirmed delivers an attached Document on confirmation (not on submit), and designs the already-confirmed and expired-token states
Offering detail shows capacity as information, never as a live seat count
admin-dashboard surfaces holds that are about to expire, because those are decisions with a deadline
Tapping a derived session block on the calendar explains where it came from and offers to open the Offering, rather than silently refusing to be edited
admin-calendar designs the empty day-one calendar, a densely booked week, and a day carrying an expired hold
admin-landing-sections shows clearly whether there are unpublished changes
admin-newsletter-edit states that sending is irreversible BEFORE the send, not after, and guards it with a confirmation naming the recipient count
admin-subscribers shows the confirmed count distinctly from the pending count, because only one of those is the real audience
Confirming a booking converts its hold into a confirmed calendar booking; declining releases the slot immediately
Password recovery via a rate-limited, single-use, short-lived emailed link, returning the same response whether or not the address matches
